note: Game-file values, except that the location list also includes places a UEX commodity terminal maps to (joins.terminals; they have no trade amenity in `am`). Positions are a static snapshot in km with the star at the origin (bodies orbit and rotate in game). No prices, stock or shop lists: those come from UEX.

illegalKinds.c<n>: Jurisdiction.controlledSubstanceClasses[n].resources; limit in controlledMaxScu[jurisdiction][n] (SCU). Which slot is the harsher class is not known.

terminals.rule: UEX terminals of type "commodity" matched to StarMapObject by star system + English name (lower case, letters and digits only, "&" = "and", text in brackets dropped). Names tried: space_station_name, outpost_name, city_name, name after its last " - ", name, nickname. Several hits are narrowed by: has a trade amenity, has a position, parent body name equals the UEX moon/planet name.

distance.method: UEX orbits_distances rows (whole Gm, orbit to orbit) against straight-line distance between game-file positions of the matched bodies. Each unordered pair counted once; pairs in two different systems are not comparable (separate coordinate frames).
distance.why: Game positions exist for all three systems at 1 km resolution and belong to the current build; UEX orbit distances are whole Gm, orbit-to-orbit only (every terminal on one orbit gets the same value) and stamped with older game versions. Use UEX distance only as a fallback for a place with no game position and no positioned body, and for crossing between systems (not a straight line).

travel.formula: flight = d/v + v/a when d > v*v/a, else 2*sqrt(d/a); computed with a = a1 and a = a2, reported as a range, seconds = middle; total = spool + flight; cooldown listed separately; fuel = fuel * d[Gm]
notValidated: when the game switches from stage one to stage two acceleration is not in the files
calibration time, route bending around bodies and jump tunnels are not modelled

other: Number and exact size of pads / hangars per location (amenities only give the largest size class).
Whether amenity tags match the live game at every location (not checked in game).
Hand / tractor loading time per box (loading.manual).

Units of boxes[].load / unload and loading.baseLoad / baseUnload (taken as seconds), loading.deckPerScu (seconds per SCU), boxes[].fee and loading.baseFee (taken as aUEC): the records hold bare numbers, the units are read from the field names only and were not confirmed in game.

Jump points: the game database has only two StarMapObject records of type JumpPoint (Stanton-Terra, Stanton-Magnus), so bodies[kind=jump] is NOT a list of jump points (none for Stanton-Pyro, none at all in Pyro and Nyx). Use locations with `gate` (the gateway stations) instead. Jump tunnel length / time is not in these files.
